hooks.command: gjalla sync --session-start 2>/dev/null || echo 'gjalla not configured. Skills work standalone. Run /gjalla-setup to connect for architecture-aware analysis.'

hooks.prompt:
Check if files were modified during this session by looking at the conversation history. If the agent created, edited, or wrote files during this session, add a brief note at the end of the response: '---
Files were modified in this session. Run /gjalla-attest to create an attestation documenting what changed and why.' Do NOT add this note if no files were modified. Do NOT block or modify the response — only append the note if applicable.

hooks.command: sh -c 'p=$(cat); case "$p" in *"git commit"*|*"git"*"commit"*) printf %s "$p" | gjalla attest add 2>/dev/null || true;; esac'
